description: Runs any operation and returns the receipt plus human-readable derivation steps. Set op, then pass the fields that operation's own tool takes. Use it when the user asks how an answer was reached.

customHolidays.description: Custom organizational holiday calendar as ISO dates (mutually exclusive with jurisdiction)

date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or "today" (resolved in tz)

days.description: Day count for add_days, subtract_days and business_days add mode.

event.description: Event slug (e.g. christmas). Exactly one of event/weekday.

from.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or "today" (resolved in tz)

invoiceDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or "today" (resolved in tz)

jurisdiction.description: Holiday jurisdiction id: US, GB, GB-SCT, GB-NIR, IE, FR, CA, AU, UG (alias UK for GB). No default: omit for no holiday calendar.

net.description: Net-N payment terms in calendar days (Net 30 = 30).

op.description: Operation to explain. holiday_lookup is the holidays tool; the others share their tool's name.

roll.description: Roll a weekend or holiday due date forward to the next business day. Default false.

to.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or "today" (resolved in tz)

tz.description: IANA timezone that defines "today" (e.g. Africa/Kampala). Default UTC.

weekday.description: 0 = Sunday .. 6 = Saturday. Exactly one of event/weekday.

name: explain

steps.description: Human-readable derivation, identical to the REST /api/v1/explain output

title: Explain a calculation step by step
